scripts.destroy: pnpm run destroy:dev && pnpm run destroy:stg && pnpm run destroy:prod
scripts.destroy:dev: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s dev && pulumi destroy -y -s dev
scripts.destroy:prod: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s prod && pulumi destroy -y -s prod
scripts.destroy:stg: RUN_TYPE=DESTROY pulumi up -y -s stg && pulumi destroy -y -s stg
scripts.up: pulumi up -y -s dev && pulumi up -y -s stg && pulumi up -y -s prod
